interpretation.before_stall: CPU1's explicitly routed interrupt is its sole enabled IRQ. An unstalled WFI round yielded no spontaneous returns and exactly one return after one guest-issued interrupt.
interpretation.during_stall: CPU0 asserted PMU stall code 0x86 and held around 2500 virtual microseconds. The core-stalled status stayed low across the second WFI, including after a new wake interrupt was issued, and CPU1 accumulated neither a return nor a heartbeat.
interpretation.release: CPU0 unstall code 0xff delivered the pending interrupt and CPU1 returned from WFI and produced 4000 late heartbeats.
interpretation.limit: The busy CPU1 positive and WFI observation use different synthetic applications. A low status bit1 by itself cannot distinguish an effectively stalled WFI core from a failed stall or establish a cause for UserDemo. UserDemo, physical hardware and ECO variants were not run.
